name: A crypto loss doesn't offset an ETF gain; it's carried forward against crypto gains
workings: ETF (an equity fund): gain 15,000.00 − 10,000.00 = 5,000.00, a reddito di capitale (TUIR art. 44 c. 1 lett. g), which no loss offsets: 26% × 5,000.00 = 1,300.00
Crypto: loss 10,000.00 − 6,000.00 = 4,000.00, in crypto's own closed basket (art. 67 c. 1 lett. c-sexies, art. 68 c. 9-bis; circolare 30/E/2023): it offsets only crypto gains
Carried forward: 4,000.00 of crypto losses from 2026, usable to 2030; in nominal euros, at an inflation factor of 1 and a plan in euros: 4,000
Selling more crypto in the same year with a 6,000.00 gain: the year's 4,000.00 loss offsets it first, 33% × (6,000.00 − 4,000.00) = 660.00
